use_case_name: Clear Exercise Surveillance Data on an Exercise Status Order

claims.content: C2 JU wants to clear Exercise Surveillance Data on an Exercise Status Order by using the J7.0 (ACT = 6) Exercise Status Order message to rapidly clear the Exercise Indicator and all artificial data from exercise tracks.

scope_contract.goal_statement: C2 JU wants to clear Exercise Surveillance Data on an Exercise Status Order by using the J7.0 (ACT = 6) Exercise Status Order message to rapidly clear the Exercise Indicator and all artificial data from exercise tracks.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: C2 JU uses the J7.0 (ACT = 6) Exercise Status Order message to clear the Exercise Indicator and all artificial data from the exercise tracks.
scope_contract.start_boundary: C2 JU has an Exercise Status Order (J7.0, ACT = 6) to apply to exercise surveillance data.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The Exercise Indicator and all artificial data are cleared from the exercise tracks.
in_scope_actions: Use the J7.0 (ACT = 6) Exercise Status Order message
Clear all artificial data from exercise tracks
excluded_adjacent_actions: Resolve field-value differences using the J7.0 (ACT = 2) Change Data Order message
Report IFF/SIF surveillance data in J3.2C1 and J3.3C1 words
Transmit the J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track Report message

claims.content: C2 JU
C2 JU has received a J7.0 (ACT = 6) Exercise Status Order message.
C2 JU's database contains tracks with the Exercise Indicator set to value 1, and data concerning those tracks is considered artificial for exercise purposes.
A JU receives a J7.0 (ACT = 6) Exercise Status Order message.
Upon receipt of a J7.0 (ACT = 6) message, C2 JU applies the order to all tracks in its database with the Exercise Indicator set to value 1.
For those tracks, C2 JU automatically sets the Identity Amplifying Descriptor to Exercise Friend.
C2 JU breaks any locally originated engagement involving the TN by transmitting a J10.2 (WES = 8) message to report the engagement broken.

C2 JU terminates any locally originated Command message with Command values 2, 3, 5, or 7 involving the TN by transmitting a J9.0 message with the Command field set to value 4 (Cease Engage), or value 5 (Hold Fire) if the Engagement Status field is set to value 4 (Firing).
For those tracks, C2 JU automatically sets all data fields that may contain artificial information to the No Statement, default value, or actual values if held in database.
For those tracks, C2 JU sets the Exercise Indicator to value 0.

missing_aspects: The cited card EC-PC-004 describes the actions taken 'Upon receipt' of the message but does not explicitly state that the C2 JU receives it or identify the sender. The claim should be restricted to the trigger condition supported by the evidence.

claims.content: Diverges from Step 4: When C2 JU terminates a locally originated Command message involving the TN and the Engagement Status field is set to value 4 (Firing), it may transmit a J9.0 message with the Command field set to value 5 (Hold Fire).

At main flow Step 5, when a data field on an exercise track is one of the fields that shall not be considered artificial for exercise purposes—Track Number; Tracking Data (Latitude, Longitude, Altitude/Elevation/Depth, Course, Speed, Minute, Hour, and Track Quality); Simulation Indicator; Environment/Category; Status Data on Air Tracks (Fuel Function, Fuel, Time Report Function, Minute, and Hour); or Status Data on Surface (Maritime) Tracks (Flight Deck Status, Landing/Approach Condition, and associated Time Report Function, Minute, and Hour)—C2 JU does not treat that field as artificial exercise data.
After main flow Step 6, when a subsequent message is received with the Exercise Indicator set to value 1, C2 JU discards that message.
After main flow Step 6, when C2 JU would originate a message with the Exercise Indicator set to value 1, it does not originate that message until local operator action is taken to reenable the JU.

missing_aspects: Documented exit/continuation after excluding non-artificial fields from artificial-data clearing

claims.content: For every track in the JU's database that had the Exercise Indicator set to value 1, the Exercise Indicator is set to value 0.
For those tracks, all data fields that may contain artificial information are set to the No Statement or default value, or to actual values if held in the database.
